title: Generating Long Sequences with Sparse Transformers for Language Modeling
text: We introduce Sparse Transformer, which uses sparse factorizations of the attention matrix to reduce the quadratic complexity of standard self-attention. We demonstrate that sparse transformers can model sequences with tens of thousands of timesteps, achieving state-of-the-art results in density modeling of text, images, and audio waveforms.
text_summary: Sparse Transformer reduces attention complexity for long-sequence language modeling and generation.
